integrity: The proof is exact and self-contained after the literature-defined functional is fixed. Convexification preserves width, a minimum-width bounding rectangle yields the lower bound, a triangle adjacent to any diameter segment yields a quantitative minimizing sequence, and equality in the bounding chain would force an impossible positive-width rectangle of ambient-diameter side length.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is planar and allows arbitrary measurable positive-area subsets of a fixed convex body. It does not treat higher-dimensional volume analogues or additional admissibility constraints that could restore existence of a minimizer.
title: Exact minimal-width–area Cheeger constant for planar convex bodies
